extraction.name: CONTEXTUAL
extraction.description: A context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning dataset with human-written instructions and ground-truth responses for evaluating multimodal models. It covers eight visual scenarios and requires joint reasoning over embedded text and visual context in images.
extraction.creator: Rohan Wadhawan, Hritik Bansal, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng
extraction.publisher: Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR)
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were collected from six sources: LAION-5B via keyword search using CLIP-retrieval UI for Time, Shopping, Navigation, and Abstract categories; the Rico Dataset for Application Usage; website links from the Open WebText Initiative for Web Usage screenshots; and test-set images from existing VQA datasets that were reannotated with novel instruction-response pairs for Infographic and Miscellaneous Natural Scenes.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Text-rich images from LAION-5B, Rico Dataset UI screens, screenshots collected from Open WebText Initiative website links, and test-set images from InfographicVQA, STVQA, and ESTVQA.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Stage 1 shortlisted images for instruction-response pair annotation using manual filtering for some categories and heuristic-based filtering for others; Stage 2 had the authors divided into two groups to annotate four categories each, strictly following provided annotation guidelines; Stage 3 used MTurk workers to verify each <image, instruction, response> sample, then the author groups reviewed the other group's samples to ensure adherence to guidelines and filter low-quality samples.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Verification found 96% of samples were annotated correctly; human evaluation was conducted on a random sample of 280 instances, and the paper reports response acceptance ratings.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: PaddleOCR (PP-OCRv4) was used to detect/extract text in images for heuristic-based filtering and OCR extraction.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The dataset was filtered and selected using manual and heuristic-based filtering; images with the highest OCR word counts were selected, and incorrect/low-quality annotated samples were filtered out during verification.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were manually or heuristically filtered for suitability; PaddleOCR was used to detect text in images, and OCR-based selection was applied before annotation.
